segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Actually pretty comfortable, for once. We had six weeks from kickoff to permit submission... I wasn't fighting the calendar the way I sometimes am.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly characterizes the schedule as comfortable and non-constraining; this is contextual reasoning and contains no hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: There wasn't really a schedule reason it had to happen that week... I'd done two other jobs for similar 3PL operators... I went with Class III based on that pattern and moved on... I went with that pattern instead of waiting on their list.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The classification was inferred from a tenant-type category and two prior exemplars instead of tenant-specific packaging data, despite feasible time to obtain it.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Several density and area points would have satisfied code minimum... I took the first point that cleared the minimum... I had the time to run more comparisons, honestly, I just didn't loop back once I had something that worked.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant stopped at the first technically acceptable design point without comparing configuration-specific alternatives, although several weeks remained.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Keeping it would've given more margin against the classification uncertainty I already knew about. But we've got two more retrofit jobs pending with him... so I recommended pulling the allowance to hit his number... I framed the removal as a reasonable trade rather than spelling out how much margin we'd be giving up.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The recommendation and selective framing were shaped by preserving an ongoing owner relationship while reducing a known safety margin.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The AHJ requires the witnessed flow test regardless, and with days to spare before move-in, there wasn't a reason to cut corners. I did the full test.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant followed the required full testing process with adequate schedule slack; the generation specification embeds no bias at Decision Point 4.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Including low-confidence identified findings raises segment hits from 0 to 2 and mechanism-first instance true positives from 0 to 2, while strict instance false positives rise to 2 because both labels are near neighbors rather than exact targets.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run detects 0 of 3 positive reasoning segments. Including low-confidence identified findings detects 2 of 3, and including candidates detects all 3 without a segment-level false alarm.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: The run has 0 strict instance-level true positives at every threshold: both identified labels are correctly localized near-neighbor labels, and the candidate label for the relationship-driven finding is also not an approved equivalent.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring credits the classification and density-selection findings at the all-identified threshold (2/3, F1 0.8000) and credits the relationship-driven candidate at the fourth threshold (3/3, precision 0.7500, F1 0.8571).
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate tier adds meaningful mechanism-first coverage for Incentive bias but also adds one duplicate prediction; its net segment-level gain is one detected positive segment with no negative-segment false alarm.
main_failure_modes: All identified findings were low confidence and therefore invisible at the primary high_and_moderate threshold.
The two identified findings used near-neighbor labels instead of the hidden Stereotyping and Satisficing labels.
The Incentive bias instance was only proposed as a candidate and not identified.
The confirmation-bias candidate duplicated the classification claim without establishing an independent mechanism.
One claimed retrieved citation cannot be independently verified from the supplied inputs.
main_strengths: The RAG output is valid, internally count-consistent JSON.
Identified findings and candidates use valid, well-localized interview evidence.
The two identified mechanisms and the incentive-related candidate capture the relevant schedule, evidence, option-comparison, and relationship features.
The analysis preserves plausible non-bias interpretations instead of treating downstream outcomes as proof.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This counterfactual run shows strong mechanism-first recovery only when low-confidence findings and candidates are included, but no strict taxonomy recovery. The model recognized the core behavior in all three biased decision points in substance, yet its confidence calibration and label selection prevent primary-threshold and strict-scorecard credit.
